svg.title: Understand first. Then change.
svg.desc: Trace the behavior. Follow the input, the rule and the result. Start with the system that exists. Find the boundary. Look past the intended path. Make ownership, authority and failure states explicit. Protect the meaning. Make a focused change. Keep the evidence. Make the consequence clear in the interface.
